cover.title: Discover the Magic of Vinyl
cover.subtitle: Explore our curated collection of premium vinyl records. From classic jazz to modern indie, we have something for every music lover.
cover.aboutSubtitle:
Founded in 2010, Vinyl Heaven started as a small corner shop with just a few hundred records. Our founder, Sarah, began collecting vinyl at age 15 and never stopped. What started as a personal collection soon grew into something much bigger.

Today, we house over 10,000 carefully curated vinyl records from every genre and era. From classic jazz to modern indie, we've handpicked each album for its quality, rarity, and cultural significance.

We believe that vinyl isn't just about nostalgia—it's about experiencing music the way artists intended, with all the warmth, depth, and character that digital formats simply can't replicate.
